definitions: A one-piece garment that covers the torso and often the arms and legs, typically worn by dancers, gymnasts, or as underwear.
A one-piece garment for an infant, similar to a onesie, that fastens at the crotch.
examples: She wore a black bodysuit for her dance performance.
The baby looked adorable in the striped bodysuit.
Many athletes prefer a form-fitting bodysuit for training.
